import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final char nl = '\n';
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v;
            this.r = r;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_NODES = 50 * T + 2;
    static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] sz = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static long mc;

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    static void init_graph(int n) {
        mc = 0;
        Arrays.fill(sz, 0, n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
        mc = Math.max(mc, c);
        adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
        adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
    }

    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] par = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static long[] pot = new long[MAX_NODES];
    static long[] dist = new long[MAX_NODES];

    static void potential_init(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.c > 0) {
                        pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long min_cost_augment(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;

        if (sparse) {
            PriorityQueue<int[]> dk = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(b[1], a[1]));
            dk.offer(new int[]{s, 0});
            while (!dk.isEmpty()) {
                int u = dk.poll()[0];
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        par[e.v] = e.r;
                        dk.offer(new int[]{e.v, (int)(-dist[e.v])});
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                vis[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        par[e.v] = e.r;
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                        best = dist[u = i];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[t] >= INF) {
            return 0;
        }

        long df = INF;
        for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
            Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
            df = Math.min(df, adj[r.v].get(r.r).c - adj[r.v].get(r.r).f);
            u = r.v;
        }

        for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
            Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
            Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
            e.f += df;
            r.f -= df;
            price[0] += df * e.p;
            u = r.v;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
        }

        return df;
    }

    static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        long flow = 0;
        price[0] = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = min_cost_augment(s, t, price, n, sparse);
            if (df == 0) break;
            flow += df;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        init_graph(MAX_NODES);

        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
